FAQ

Common Questions

Who is A V Ajay Kiran?

A V Ajay Kiran is an AI Growth and Digital Transformation Leader based in Hyderabad, India, also working across the UAE. He has 14+ years of experience combining AI product development, SEO and performance marketing, UX strategy and workflow automation. He is also known as Ajay Kiran and works under the Designjoom brand.

What does A V Ajay Kiran do?

He leads growth strategy across AI, SEO, social media, content, UX, performance marketing and automation, and manages a multidisciplinary team of six covering graphic design, content creation and social media. His work spans digital transformation programmes, AI-powered product builds and UX strategy for enterprise tools.

How many years of experience does he have?

He has 14+ years of professional experience, beginning with digital marketing strategy at Vedic IT Solutions in 2012. He has since worked as a growth hacker at Logos GmbH in Berlin, a lead UX and brand consultant at Vigilare Bio Pharma, and currently leads AI growth and digital strategy at DIGIT AI.

What results has he delivered?

Verified results include 180%+ organic traffic growth at Logos GmbH over a five-year engagement, +99% website traffic and +93% new users for a healthcare client, 60,900+ video views and 2,534 new users on the IR4U digital ecosystem, and 33,248 impressions across 48 LinkedIn posts for Vigilare Bio Pharma.

Where is he based and does he work remotely?

He is based in Hyderabad, India and works with clients across India, Germany, the US and Australia. His roles at Logos GmbH in Berlin and with Vigilare Bio Pharma have been remote and enterprise-facing, so he is comfortable working across time zones and distributed teams.

What AI and growth tools does he use?

His toolkit spans generative AI, LLM workflows, prompt engineering, AI content and video production, and workflow automation. For growth he uses GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Hotjar, Mixpanel, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Semrush and Ahrefs, plus Figma, FigJam, WordPress and Elementor.

Is he available for roles and projects?

Yes. He is available for AI growth, digital transformation and UX strategy roles, and for consulting engagements spanning AI workflow architecture, growth strategy and UX transformation. He can be reached by email at ajayspi@gmail.com or by phone on +91 98853 69345.
